name: ProductCard
description: Figma-backed YAMI product tile. Rich remains the default and preserves the existing DOM contract; minimal and compact presentations support image-first and horizontal list contexts.

figma.notes: Product Card - Desktop, Style=Grid - Standard with BG, Page=Homepage. ProductCardAddButton remains separately connected to 2410:30647.

presentation.description: Non-breaking visual presentation. Rich preserves the original full product anatomy, minimal shows image with price badge and quick add, and compact uses a left-image horizontal row.

surface.description: Outer spacing context. Card uses 4px padding when placed over a background; plain removes outer padding.

image.description: Image URL. When provided, imageAlt is required. When absent, the theme-aware neutral placeholder is rendered.

imageAlt.description: Alt text. For decorative product cards in a list where title carries the product identity, pass empty string.

imageLoading.description: Native image loading strategy. Set eager for above-fold cards.

imageFetchPriority.description: Native fetch priority. Use high only for an above-fold LCP candidate.

brand.description: Brand name above title (GT Walsheim 500, caption-md).

brandHref.description: Brand destination used by the trailing-arrow link.

priceCurrent.description: Display string for current price. Colored --text-emphasis (red).

priceOriginal.description: Original price with strike-through. Omit when no discount.

unitPrice.description: Unit or bundle price text, including pack information when relevant.

ranking.description: Ranking signal rendered as a yellow secondary Badge.

rating.description: 0-5 star rating, rendered to 1 decimal (4.8). Omit to hide rating row.

soldCount.description: Sold count displayed after rating metadata.

promotions.description: Ordered loyalty and campaign rows below pricing.

badges.description: Product-image badges arranged top-left. Only sale, low-price, discount, new, hot, exclusive, and choice are allowed. Max 2 rendered; invalid types are ignored and extras are truncated.

onAddToCart.description: Callback for the independent ProductCardAddButton. Omit to hide the child action.

addButtonAriaLabel.description: Accessible name for ProductCardAddButton. Defaults to Add to cart.

href.description: Product destination used by the title link. Rating, pricing, promotion, and countdown content remain independently targetable.

redUsage.note: priceCurrent uses --text-emphasis (red) per the 'promotion / urgency' allowed category.

numerals.note: Prices + rating number render in var(--font-family-ios) = GT Walsheim.

noEmoji.note: Rating and action icons are SVG; campaign and badge copy remains text-only.

cardBorder.note: Outer Card uses default (no border). For grid density, the parent ProductGrid may add a hairline divider.

typeHierarchy.note: Uses exactly 4 levels: brand caption / title body / price price / rating caption. No hierarchy overflow.

quickAdd.note: ProductCardAddButton follows Figma 2410:30647: 40px visual size at every width with a 44px minimum pointer target. Compact rows place it beside price; rich and minimal cards retain the media overlay. Its colors are theme-independent semantics, not inverse-mode aliases.

accessibility.ariaPattern: article containing a required product-title link and an independent optional quick-add button
accessibility.structure: Image with alt (required when src) or aria-hidden placeholder. Badges use semantic <span>. Rating has aria-label 'Rating X out of 5'.
accessibility.interaction: Only the product title navigates to the product destination. Brand and Add remain independent controls; Add has a required aria-label.
